load_error: Current information could not be loaded. Try again.
save_error: The operation could not be completed. You can retry the same request.
version_conflict: This record changed while you were editing. Review current information before saving.
reconcile_help: Current information is loaded. Discard the draft and start editing the latest information.
validation_error: The input was rejected. Correct the fields and start a new request.
pending_help: Unresolved requests remain here across filter changes. Retrying uses the same operation, body and key. Review current information and explicitly discard the previous request before starting another.
title: Products
discover_description: Organize products, projects and environment addresses in one catalog.
name: Product name
repository_help: Repository addresses and references are descriptive records. They do not establish an integration or connection status.
url_error: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS address of at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes without embedded credentials or secret query parameters.
restore_help: Restoring a product leaves archived environments archived.
stale_draft: This draft uses an earlier version. Discard it to edit the current information.
projects_help: The complete project list is saved together. New selections must be active projects. Existing associations with archived projects may be retained.
environments_help: Environment addresses and deployment references are catalog metadata. They do not run deployments or indicate live deployment status.
deploy_help: Save links and descriptive references only; do not enter secret keys or credentials.
snapshot_changed: Product information is refreshing or changed while loading. Reload the product and environments together to continue.
